messages:
zoe: heads up — our GitHub Actions job for the sample app just started failing on CI with HTTP 402 when calling the hosted API. Locally works fine with my personal key.

raj: can you paste the GH secret name and the exact error from the workflow logs?

zoe: secret is REDWOOD_API_KEY (org secret at repo level). Workflow log shows: 

  Request POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  Response 402 Payment Required
  Body: {"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace billing_required"}

ci-bot: workflow run 8421 failed on step "call redwood API" — exit code 1. See https://github.com/org/sample-app/actions/runs/8421 for logs.

sdk-team: 402 indicates the key is from a workspace with billing disabled. Org secrets often contain the workspace key. Did you add the key under Account or Workspace?

zoe: the secret was added by our infra script which pulled the workspace key (we wanted everyone to use the team key). I didn't realize workspace keys could be blocked for CI. Any recommended pattern?

raj: two recommended flows: (1) add a billing method to the workspace so the workspace key works in CI, (2) use a machine user/personal key stored as a secret dedicated to CI (Account-level key), or (3) use the local rdw emulator for offline tests.

zoe: switched to a personal project key, updated the secret, re-ran workflow, job passed — first successful CI call! :tada:

sdk-team: thanks for confirming. Noted issues: (a) SDK currently surfaces billing errors as multiple HTTP codes (401/403/402) depending on where it fails, (b) workflow errors are noisy (requests exception stacktrace only), (c) no preflight check in quickstart to validate key scope or workspace billing state.

zoe: quick idea: quickstart script could run a lightweight /v1/whoami or /v1/account call and print a clear hint: "This key belongs to workspace X which requires billing: https://app.redwood.ai/workspace/X/billing". Would save a lot of time.

billing-bot: workspace acme-ci status: TRIAL_EXPIRED -> billing_required. To restore hosted API for workspace keys add a payment method at https://app.redwood.ai/workspace/acme-ci/billing or contact billing@redwood.ai.

raj: filing DX ticket: DX-5001 quickstart: add key-sanity check + clearer message in CI logs. Also opening SDK ticket to normalize billing errors and include error.help_url.

sdk-team: plan: add a small API call in client.startup() that returns {owner_type, owner_name, billing_status} when debug=true, and expose error.help_url for billing_required. We'll make the client error object include error.code = "billing_required" and help_url.

zoe: also add a note to the sample-app README about org secrets vs personal keys for CI. I opened a tiny PR with that change.

ci-bot: created issue sample-app#78 referencing DX-5001 and linked PR #101.

zoe: resolved for now. Leaving thread in case someone else hits CI failures from org secrets.
